races.display_title: Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict: Plenty of these look longer-term projects but CHOCTAW NATION shaped promisingly behind one who set a tall standard for a maiden on debut at Navan 25 days ago. Beating the rest handsomely himself on that occasion, he's clearly another above-average Ballydoyle colt and rates the one to beat with improvement forthcoming. Book of Kells and State of Play are a couple of likely newcomers before betting clues, with Cracks and Sparks and Adversity completing the shortlist. CHOCTAW NATION (IRE) BOOK OF KELLS (IRE) STATE OF PLAY (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Choctaw Nation (11/4), Piero Manzoni (6/1), Wassily Kandinsky (6/1), Book Of Kells (6/1), Adversity (7/1), Thunder Bay (8/1), State Of Play (10/1), Erico (10/1), Favour Royal (16/1), Too Too Much (16/1), Cracks And Sparks (16/1), Bright Dream (25/1), Etawann (33/1), Byzantine Gold (50/1), Rock On Johnny (66/1), System Reset (66/1), Grecian Pearl (66/1), Silent Promise (66/1), Blue Glory (100/1), Tinshona (100/1), Eastern Passage (100/1), One Point Five (200/1), The Pintline (200/1)

races.verdict: There's a feeling at least one of the several unexposed sorts in this line-up will come to the fore, with Olly Murphy's KINGS CHAMPION top of the list. Dan Skelton pair Saracen Beau (a new recruit for the stable) and Broomfield Aderra appeal as likely improvers on their second chase starts. The Dog Thief and High Tea are other interesting additions to the chase ranks. KINGS CHAMPION (FR) SARACEN BEAU (IRE) BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)
